trigger: two same-name registry entries whose versions compare equal but differ as strings (1.0 and 1, 01 and 1, 1-0 and 1.0, 1.0.0 and 1) plus any change to the rest of the list; std::sort is unstable
classification_rationale: the header comment and changelog bullet say the kept entry does not depend on input order; a measured harness shows the survivor flips
summary: dedup keeps the highest version by compare_versions but equal-comparing byte-different versions tie, so the kept version string depends on the sort layout (measured: one unrelated added entry flips it in 613 of 2000 layouts). compute_software_events compares version with != so a flip records a spurious upgraded event. Five reviewers raised it independently (cpp-expert, docs-writer, quality-engineer, security-guardian, and the run's own measurement); their native bands were LOW or SHOULD (read as cosmetic), the derived band is HIGH (I3). Fix: byte tie-break after compare_versions == 0 plus a permutation and shuffle test.

adjudicated_by: governance gate runner (Gate 7 adjudication; not the change author and not the reporter of the finding)
adjudication_rationale: the reporter claimed the false-green-test policy floor; that floor covers a test offered as closure evidence for a blocking finding, and this test closes no recorded blocking finding (the code-review report lists it as proof for a spec row). Graded SHOULD and fixed in the same round because the fix is one line.
trigger: reintroduce the long long overflow in compare_versions
classification_rationale: the test is named for overflow safety and cannot observe overflow
summary: All five checks of the long numeric segment test pass on the old overflowing comparator (compiled at the base commit). Fix: add compare_versions of 18446744073709551617 against 1 and 18446744073709551616 against 0, both expected greater.

classification_rationale: the plan-amended consequence has no test; the printed wire line is also asserted nowhere
summary: No test checks retention_clock_events after a corrupt-stored pass on an idle store, none covers a corrupt reading with a failing set_config, and the retention_guard_failed line for the sentinel is not asserted. Bounded blast radius.

classification_rationale: the manual states a cause for warehouse_tables_ok=false that is only partly true and under-describes the stored-reading trigger
summary: No operator action for the new token; trigger 3 says ahead only while the code also covers unparseable and negative readings; the failures total is described as counting tables; the byte-budget skip is not stated; the wrong-shape cause of a failed warehouse create is partly untrue and no action is given; the errored-recovery bullet omits the one-time started burst on diff sources.

trigger: a reader looks up echo status output in the plugin README
classification_rationale: the plugin README standard row asks a src touch to update the README or state docs-unchanged
summary: The hand-authored status paragraph omits the two new config lines and the new retention token, and the commits state no docs-unchanged line.

trigger: a reader of the retention register after merge
classification_rationale: the Clock-guarded retention row names this register as the recorded reasoning for a changed retention pass (item 6 update obligation)
summary: The Echo byte-budget row omits the __implausible_now__ and __implausible_stored__ sentinels and that a stale-ahead stored reading skips the budget once on an idle device.

trigger: a maintainer reads the comparator or the retention comment
classification_rationale: comments contradict the code but sit beside no security or control-flow branch
summary: The comparator comment says it mirrors the vuln_scan comparator, which the change deliberately diverges from; the retention comment says the reading is re-anchored and counted once, which does not hold when set_config fails; the changelog bullet cites only #7482 for the version change and omits the budget skip.

trigger: the stored retention anchor cannot be written (disk full, read-only or locked store) while the pass runs
classification_rationale: the byte-budget skip is documented as a response to a refused clock, but a failed persist also triggers it
summary: A failed anchor persist counts under __clock_state__ every pass and so skips the byte-budget pass every pass; the new sentinel counts a second time for one cause. I5(b) was considered and not applied because a store that rejects the anchor write usually rejects the budget deletes too; not proven. Design call filed.

trigger: an operator or auditor reads the definition, runbook or SOC 2 page
classification_rationale: three documents equate a non-zero failures total with retention stopped; none is a required doc under the six-item definition
summary: echo.yaml, the storage-offline runbook and the SOC 2 first-customer page describe the failures total as tables that could not be retained, which the sentinels no longer fit.

trigger: errored to true on a diff or interval source, or a failing baseline clear
classification_rationale: no counter or gap marker records the recovery, and a failed clear logs nothing
summary: Recovery leaves one warning only; cursor sources emit capture_gap, diff sources do not; a rolled-back clear leaves the flag errored with no signal. Same property as the disable edge.

trigger: two registry names differing only in invalid bytes that the later scrub rewrites
classification_rationale: the collector assumes unique names after dedup but the scrub runs afterwards
summary: dedup runs in the Windows collector before scrub_wire_strings in software_collect_core, so names that collide after the scrub keep a duplicate and report upgraded each tick. Likelihood low; not verifiable on the review host.

trigger: a refactor drops a log line, the do_configure reset or the warehouse_tables_ok false wiring
classification_rationale: no test observes the three new log lines, the reset call site or the false path of warehouse_tables_ok
summary: Known and accepted for the log lines and the reset call site; the warehouse_tables_ok false path and the test hygiene items were added to the existing follow-up.

trigger: a device opens its store without every warehouse table
classification_rationale: the flag is visible through echo status on the device only
summary: No server health or fleet metric consumes config|warehouse_tables_ok; the existing fleet-surfacing issue is the home for it.

refuted_by: echo_plugin.cpp:1230 gates every dispatch on online_.load(acquire); lines 631-634 and 1114 store online_ last with release; retry_open is the only db_ writer while the gate is closed (read by the Gate 3 reviewer and re-read by the gate runner)
refuted_by_reporter: cpp-safety (Gate 3 reviewer; not the change author)
trigger: a status call racing retry_open assigning db_
classification_rationale: the claim is that status reads db_ unguarded
summary: Refuted: dispatch is gated by an acquire load of online_, which retry_open stores last with release; the new flag is written only in open() before publication.

trigger: a transient failure of the warehouse DDL at open
classification_rationale: the flag describes one open, by design
summary: The flag is per open: open() re-runs the create on every open and retry_open builds a fresh object. Documented as set once in open().

trigger: a 100 kB version string or about 1000 same-name entries
classification_rationale: a performance worry about the comparator
summary: The comparator is linear with no integer conversion; 10 MB inputs ran in 55 ms in the security reviewer's sanitizer harness.

trigger: an honest backward clock step puts the stored reading ahead of now
classification_rationale: one failure and one skipped budget pass for a self-healing event
summary: Matches the existing per-table decline for the same state and self-heals on the re-anchor; the wording consequence is covered by the operator docs issue.

trigger: an actor rewrites the retention anchor before every pass
classification_rationale: the actor needs write access to echo_config
summary: The actor can already lower db_budget_bytes, so no capability is gained (E2 does not apply); the direction is fail-safe (no deletion). Accepted trade-off.
